# Tern

> Encrypted messaging in 465 KB. No phone number. Built for weak networks.

Tern is a tiny end-to-end encrypted messenger from Nomli Tech Limited.
Public site pages (all crawlable):

- [Home](https://tern.niilox.com/): product overview and size claims
- [Privacy](https://tern.niilox.com/privacy/): how data is handled
- [Terms](https://tern.niilox.com/terms/): terms of use
- [Delete account](https://tern.niilox.com/delete/): how to request account deletion

Contact: support-tern@niilox.com
